source: start.sh of MiaAI-Lab/DeepSeek-v4-Flash-One-DGX-Spark at the commit this version names
notes: Defaults are the upstream repository's, not any operator's fork. That is deliberate: canonicalization drops a value that equals the default, so if a fork's local override were seeded here the override would vanish from the fingerprint. ABLATE in particular defaults to 0 upstream, so a run with refusal-direction ablation on carries ABLATE=1 explicitly. Parameter names are recorded lower-case and hyphenated to satisfy the registry id pattern; each help string names the upper-case environment variable start.sh actually reads.

params.name: max-model-len
params.help: Context window the KV pool is sized for. Environment variable: MAX_MODEL_LEN.

params.name: max-num-seqs
params.help: Concurrent sequences admitted. 1 is a single-deep-context profile; raise it for serving. Environment variable: MAX_NUM_SEQS.

params.name: max-num-batched-tokens
params.help: Also sizes and locks the b12x MLA workspace after warmup; lowering it to recover KV crashes later on a wide attend. Environment variable: MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS.

params.name: gpu-memory-utilization
params.help: Fraction of the unified 128 GB the engine may claim. Environment variable: GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION.

params.name: mode
params.help: Inference path: dspark enables the speculative draft-expert route. Environment variable: MODE.

params.name: ablate
params.help: Runtime refusal-direction ablation. Changes what the model will answer, so it changes eval scores; it is not a performance knob. Environment variable: ABLATE.

params.name: dsv4-ablate-lambda
params.help: Strength of the ablation direction. Only read when ABLATE=1. Environment variable: DSV4_ABLATE_LAMBDA.

params.name: dsv4-ablate-layers
params.help: Layer range the ablation direction is applied to. Only read when ABLATE=1. Environment variable: DSV4_ABLATE_LAYERS.

params.name: dspark-tokens
params.help: Speculative tokens proposed per step. Environment variable: DSPARK_TOKENS.

params.name: dspark-draft-experts
params.help: Experts the draft pass may route to. Environment variable: DSPARK_DRAFT_EXPERTS.

params.name: dspark-dynamic-draft-depth
params.help: Vary draft depth with acceptance rate. Environment variable: DSPARK_DYNAMIC_DRAFT_DEPTH.

params.name: dspark-dynamic-draft-depth-window
params.help: Window over which acceptance is measured for dynamic draft depth. Environment variable: DSPARK_DYNAMIC_DRAFT_DEPTH_WINDOW.

params.name: dspark-structured-experts-per-category
params.help: Experts held per output category by the structured router. Environment variable: DSPARK_STRUCTURED_EXPERTS_PER_CATEGORY.

params.name: dspark-capacity
params.help: Draft capacity override; 0 lets the engine choose. Environment variable: DSPARK_CAPACITY.

params.name: long-prefill-token-threshold
params.help: Chunk size above which a prefill is split for fairness; 0 disables. Caps prefill throughput when set below MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS. Environment variable: LONG_PREFILL_TOKEN_THRESHOLD.

params.name: max-num-partial-prefills
params.help: Partial prefills allowed in flight; 0 disables. Environment variable: MAX_NUM_PARTIAL_PREFILLS.

params.name: kv-offload-gb
params.help: KV cache offloaded to host memory. Environment variable: KV_OFFLOAD_GB.

params.name: kv-fp8-rope
params.help: Store RoPE-applied keys in fp8. Environment variable: KV_FP8_ROPE.

params.name: kv-record
params.help: KV layout record the pool is built from. Environment variable: KV_RECORD.

params.name: vllm-use-simple-kv-offload
params.help: Use the simple offload path rather than the paged one. Environment variable: VLLM_USE_SIMPLE_KV_OFFLOAD.

params.name: vllm-use-b12x-wo-projection
params.help: b12x MLA output projection kernel. Environment variable: VLLM_USE_B12X_WO_PROJECTION.

params.name: vllm-dsv4-padded-nvfp4
params.help: Pad NVFP4 tensors for the fused kernel. Environment variable: VLLM_DSV4_PADDED_NVFP4.

params.name: max-cudagraph-capture-size
params.help: Largest batch captured into a CUDA graph. Environment variable: MAX_CUDAGRAPH_CAPTURE_SIZE.

params.name: cudagraph-capture-sizes
params.help: Batch sizes captured into CUDA graphs. Environment variable: CUDAGRAPH_CAPTURE_SIZES.

params.name: vllm-memory-profiler-estimate-cudagraphs
params.help: Let the memory profiler estimate CUDA graph cost instead of measuring it. Environment variable: VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS.

params.name: default-chat-template-kwargs-thinking
params.help: Thinking on by default in the chat template. Changes output token counts by a large factor. Environment variable: DEFAULT_CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS_THINKING.

params.name: default-chat-template-kwargs-effort
params.help: Reasoning effort passed to the chat template. Environment variable: DEFAULT_CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS_EFFORT.

params.name: extra-vllm-args
params.help: Raw arguments appended to the server command. Environment variable: EXTRA_VLLM_ARGS.
